title: Analysis scripts for: Desmin (DES) in lung adenocarcinoma reflects tissue composition
description: Python scripts and result tables reproducing the TCGA-LUAD, CPTAC, CCLE, Lung Cancer Atlas (CELLxGENE Census) and Visium (BioStudies E-MTAB-13530) analyses of the article. Input data are public and downloaded by 00_download_data.py.
